adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the helper calls `schema.safeParse(...)` but immediately `throw`s when `!refreshTokenResponse.success`, so any return value necessarily has `success: true`. Yet call sites treat the return as a normal `SafeParseReturnType`: e.g. Salesforce does `if (!accessTokenParsed.success) { ... }` after calling `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)`, which is unreachable, and Office365 uses `(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data)` which is redundant because failure would have thrown earlier. This is diff-grounded misleading/dead-branch logic, though it doesn’t by itself prove a runtime defect in the new behavior.
